title: Existence of solution for Schrödinger-Newton system with vanishing magnetic potential
summary: In this paper, we study the following Schrödinger-Newton system with a vanishing magnetic potential and an electric potential \begin{equation}\label{0.1} \left\{ \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.25} \begin{array}{ll} (-i\nabla +A(x))^2u+V(x)u=Φu, \ & x\in\mathbb{R}^3,\\ -ΔΦ=|u|^2, \ & x\in\mathbb{R}^3, \end{array} \right. \end{equation} where $i$ is the imaginary unit, $A:\mathbb{R}^3\to \mathbb{R}^3$ is a continuous magnetic potential, and $V:\mathbb{R}^3\to \mathbb{R}$ is a continuous electric potential.
